name: The Great Meridian Monument
coordinate_frame: glTF metres, Y-up, +Z front, origin (0, 0, 0) at midpoint of +Z front curb

1926.label: Dedication
1926.summary: Clean limestone, glowing fresh orange-brown copper spire, cornice bunting swags, flagpole-base bunting, timber dedication stand, gas lamps, young trees.

1941.label: Mature / Wartime
1941.summary: Slightly darkened stone with faint drips, streaky brown-green copper, 1941-1945 bronze war plaque, sandbags at main stairs, taped X-cross hall windows, mature trees.

1976.label: Worn / Stalled Repairs
1976.summary: Heavy dark cornice drips, deep black-streaked green copper, paving weeds, chipped Industry gear, tarped SE pier scaffolding + chain-link fence, 'CLOSED FOR REPAIRS' North stair sawhorse, beacon off, 3 broken lamps, East telescope missing.

2000.label: Restored & Accessible
2000.summary: Cleaned pale stone, restored streak-free bright verdigris copper, visible LED floodlight fixtures, East accessibility ramp, SW Visitor Centre, 1 m interpretive panels, trash bins, bike rack.

sphere_floods.description: Warm gold uplighting on 18 m sphere

collision.coordinate_frame: glTF metres (Y-up, +Z front — same frame as doors)
